crew.overview: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.
crew.title: Baby Driver

details.biography: Ebony Elaine Hardin is Producer raised in Charlotte, NC. She's worked with NBCUniversal, Netflix, CBS, TriStar, Focus Features and CH Media on various TV series and films including Sense8, Pretty Little Liars, Baby Driver, Nocturnal Animals, Jason Bourne, and Dimension 20, among others. She produced the short film, Mr. Talented, which screened at Austin Film Festival and competed in the HBO Short Film Competition at Martha's Vineyard African American Film Festival. Ebony is a 2017 NCBW Maya Angelou Phenomenal Woman Award Winner, a 2022 Film Independent Project Involve Producing Fellow, and a 2023 TBA Producing Fellow. She holds a BFA in Drama from Carnegie Mellon School University .
details.name: Ebony Hardin
